text: The Message of God through the prophet Jeremiah on Babylon, land of the Chaldeans:

Go public with this, broadcast it far and wide: Babylon taken, god-Bel hanging his head in shame, god-Marduk exposed as a fraud. All her god-idols shuffling in shame, all her play-gods exposed as cheap frauds.
reduce her cities to rubble. Empty of life—no animals, no people— not a sound, not a movement, not a breath.
"the people of Israel will come, And the people of Judah with them. Walking and weeping, they'll seek me, their God.
and set their faces toward Zion. They'll come and hold tight to God, bound in a covenant eternal they'll never forget.
Their shepherds led them astray. They abandoned them in the mountains where they wandered aimless through the hills. They lost track of home, couldn't remember where they came from.
Their enemies had no qualms: 'Fair game' they said. 'They walked out on God. They abandoned the True Pasture, the hope of their parents.'
Be rid of that Babylonian country. On your way. Good sheepdogs lead, but don't you be led. Lead the way home!
I'm rallying a host of nations against Babylon. They'll come out of the north, attack and take her. Oh, they know how to fight, these armies. They never come home empty-handed.
All her plunderers will fill their bellies!" God's Decree.
You lived it up, exploiting and using my people, Frisky calves romping in lush pastures, wild stallions out having a good time!
The woman who bore you wouldn't be pleased. Look at what's come of you! A nothing nation! Rubble and garbage and weeds!
a desert of death and emptiness. Travelers who pass by Babylon will gasp, appalled, shaking their heads at such a comedown.
Throw everything you have against her. Hold nothing back. Knock her flat. She's sinned—oh, how she's sinned, against me!

All the fight has gone out of her. Her defenses have been flattened, her walls smashed. 'Operation God's Vengeance.' Pile on the vengeance! Do to her as she has done. Give her a good dose of her own medicine!
ravage her fields, empty her barns. And you captives, while the destruction rages, get out while the getting's good, get out fast and run for home.
hunted down by lions. The king of Assyria started the carnage. The king of Babylon, Nebuchadnezzar, Has completed the job, gnawing the bones clean."
the God of Israel, has to say: "Just watch! I'm bringing doom on the king of Babylon and his land, the same doom I brought on the king of Assyria.
He'll graze on the hills of Carmel and Bashan, On the slopes of Ephraim and Gilead. He will eat to his heart's content.
"they'll look high and low for a sign of Israel's guilt—nothing; Search nook and cranny for a trace of Judah's sin—nothing. These people that I've saved will start out with a clean slate.
Go after Pekod, country of doom! Hunt them down. Make a clean sweep." God's Decree. "These are my orders. Do what I tell you.
shakes the foundations!
smashed and splintered, Babylon pummeled beyond recognition.
O Babylon, you never knew what hit you, Caught and held in the steel grip of that trap! That's what you get for taking on God.
I brought out my weapons of wrath. The Master, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, has a job to do in Babylon.
Break into her granaries! Shovel her into piles and burn her up. Leave nothing! Leave no one!
Send them to their doom! Doom to them! Yes, Doomsday! The clock has finally run out on them.
Runaways and escapees from Babylon Show up in Zion reporting the news of God's vengeance, taking vengeance for my own Temple.

anyone who can shoot straight! Tighten the noose! Leave no loopholes! Give her back as good as she gave, a dose of her own medicine! Her brazen insolence is an outrage against God, The Holy of Israel.
her soldiers dead, silent forever." God's Decree.
Decree of the Master, God-of-the-Angel-Armies. "Time's run out on you: That's right: It's Doomsday.
No one will offer him a hand. I'll set his towns on fire. The fire will spread wild through the country."
"The people of Israel are beaten down, the people of Judah along with them. Their oppressors have them in a grip of steel. They won't let go.
God-of-the-Angel-Armies. Yes, I will take their side, I'll come to their rescue. I'll soothe their land, but rough up the people of Babylon.
"total war against people, leaders, and the wise!
War to the death on her soldiers, cowards to a man!
War to the death on her banks—looted!
A land of make-believe gods gone crazy—hobgoblins!
night-owls and vampire bats. No one will ever live there again. The land will reek with the stench of death.
the cities I did away with." God's Decree. "No one will live there again. No one will again draw breath in that land, ever.
out of the north, hordes of people, A mob of kings stirred up from far-off places.
barbarians they are, cruel and pitiless. Roaring and relentless, like ocean breakers, they come riding fierce stallions, In battle formation, ready to fight you, Daughter Babylon!
He goes white as a ghost, limp as a dishrag. Terror-stricken, he doubles up in pain, helpless to fight, like a woman giving birth to a baby.

from the thick jungle of the Jordan, Looking for prey in the mountain pastures, I'll take over and pounce. I'll take my pick of the flock—and who's to stop me? All the so-called shepherds are helpless before me."
Believe it or not, the young, the vulnerable—mere lambs and kids—will be dragged off. Believe it or not, the flock in shock, helpless to help, watches it happen.
the very earth will shudder at the sound. The news will be heard all over the world.
